title: Captain Jack's Lake Cruise

services.name: Charter Cruises
services.desc: Captain Jack has been boating on Lake Hamilton for over 30 years. He knows the lake and he knows how to navigate the risks on this busy lake. Boating with Captain Jack is convenient. With a Charter Cruise we can usually pick you up from your dock, depending upon the location. Captain Jack's cruises and charters are less expensive than renting your own pontoon. Only $45 per person for our Day Cruises and $60 per person for our Sunset Cruise. Why go through the hassle of renting your own boat? With Captain Jack's Lake Cruises there are no deposits, fuel charges, or worries about damaging the boat or bringing it back late. You can relax and not stress over hitting another boat or running over
